description: Repository-grounded reasoning checks, not ECDSA security certification or a model evaluation benchmark.

tasks.question: Does the Lean generic discrete-log lower bound certify security against coordinate-based Semaev polynomial attacks? Identify the scope and the next proof obligation.
Which mathematical assumptions still prevent the characteristic-zero S-unit ramp calculation from proving a finite-field ECDSA lower bound?
What permits FreeExtension.lean to infer all-height non-refutation from finite base measurements? Which extra evidence is required for a new degree?
Can the split or Dickson tower results be transferred directly to deployed secp256k1? State the missing structural route.
Has the Strategy IV toy tensor-contraction experiment established a finite ECDLP speedup over an automorphism-aware generic algorithm?
Does achieving relation-space rank imply efficient acquisition of usable nonzero-tagged equations for recovering a discrete logarithm?
